answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 632 identities costs 632 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the jetty here is verification, the beacon of cost is what stops the farm, and the ember of the record keeps every claim checkable.
